overview_description.description:
Catch&Release is an end-to-end content licensing platform that enables brands and advertisers to license content from anywhere on the internet. Streamline the clearance and licensing process within the Content Exchange, a licensing platform where users can organize shots from anywhere on the internet, receive Clearance Ratings to understand what content is licensable, and initiate clearances and licensing at the click of a button. 

Catch&Release negotiates copyright and model clearances on your behalf, provides indemnification, and keeps track of all documentation, transactions, and license data.

product.name: Catch+Release Content Licensing Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that enables brands and agencies to search, curate, and license authentic online content from various social media and internet sources.

product.name: Curation Services
product.description: Expert curation services that find and deliver content assets tailored to a client’s campaign brief, vision, budget, and timeline.

product.name: Managed Licensing Services
product.description: A managed service where Catch+Release’s Customer Success team guides clients through the entire content licensing and clearance process.

product.name: Specialized Licensing Services
product.description: Licensing clearance for complex content types including celebrities, sports, archival footage, soundbites, music, and literary works.

product.name: Creator Community Workspace
product.description: A collaborative workspace for creators to showcase content and connect with brands for licensing opportunities.
